[EN] You hunted hyenas at Filton's ranch.
[ES] Cazaste hienas en el rancho de Filton.

[EN] Hi, ! I was hoping you'd come by.

Those hyenas are back. Can I ask you to drive them off again? "Yes."
[ES] ¡Hola, ! Esperaba que vinieras.

Esas hienas han vuelto. ¿Puedo pedirte que las ahuyentes otra vez? "Yes."

[EN] You are so awesome, . Are you sure you don't want to settle down and become a rancher?

Well, all right. Here, take this fresh milk as a reward. And feel free to come back any time! "It was no trouble!"
[ES] Eres genial, . ¿De verdad no quieres afincarte y convertirte en ranchero?

Bueno, está bien. Toma, ¡recibe esta leche fresca como recompensa! ¡Y no dudes en volver cuando quieras! "It was no trouble!"
